t: A large fire began in London's Pudding Lane and burned for five days, destroying St Paul's Cathedral and the homes of 70,000 of the city's 80,000 inhabitants.
The most destructive damage from the Great Fire of London occurred.
The Royal Scots Army led by Tam Dalyell of the Binns suppressed an uprising by Covenanter insurgents under James Wallace of Auchens near the Pentland Hills in Scotland.
